async def act(page):
    # Fill the search textbox with the phone number
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search by keyword').fill('+1 2058812302')
    # Click the search button
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
    # Wait for the page to update after search
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Check if any customer rows are present in the table
    rows = page.get_by_role('row')
    # Skip the header row (first row in rowgroup)
    # Look for rows that contain customer data (should have cells with name and email)
    for i in range(await rows.count()):
        row = rows.nth(i)
        cells = row.get_by_role('cell')
        if await cells.count() >= 2:  # At least name and email cells
            # Get the text content of the name and email cells
            name = await cells.nth(0).text_content()
            email = await cells.nth(1).text_content()
            # If name and email are not empty, return them as-is
            if name.strip() and email.strip():
                return f"Customer Name: {name}, Email: {email}"
    # If no customer found, return a message
    return "No customer found with phone number +1 2058812302"
